notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.3 SR12: with DESTINATION TABLE OCCURS "data-name-4 and data-name-5 may be referenced only by subscripting". BuildArea nests both under an unnamed OCCURS integer-1 group (GR16's implicit description), so ScreenSubscriptArity refuses an unsubscripted reference (COBOL2270) and a wrong subscript count (COBOL2097), and SEARCH cannot name them. Probed: OUT-DEST and OUT-ERR in MOVE and IF, OUT-DEST(1:3), OUT-DEST(1 1), OUT-DEST() and SEARCH OUT-DEST refused; OUT-DEST(1), OUT-DEST(IX - 1) and OUT-DEST(2)(1:4) accepted and correct. Diagnostics cite §2023 rules (PB4950 class). The witness refuses an unsubscripted OUT-DEST.

next.reason: 1985: "If the DESTINATION TABLE OCCURS clause is specified, data-name-4 and data-name-5 may be referenced only by subscripting."; 2023: "No 2023 clause holds the communication description entry or DESTINATION TABLE OCCURS; the CD feature is absent". No 2023 clause holds the CD entry. No candidate covers DESTINATION TABLE OCCURS; SR-14.9.39.3-35's data-name-4/5 are SET message-tag operands, an unrelated subject.
